_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Euratom Research and Training Programme (EURATOM) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"euratom"} to apply.

queries.FuseNet Call for the Organisation of Min: contenttype=project AND ("nuclear fusion" OR "fusion energy" OR "magnetic confinement" OR "plasma physics") AND ("education" OR "training" OR "workshop" OR "summer school")
